emma (ml-eng): Quick afternoon sweep: A100 vs H100 across eu-west1 / us-west2 for mistral-7b, mosaic-7b, and llama2-7b. Uploaded plots to the bench dashboard. TL;DR: H100 wins decode p99 and tokens/sec, gives modest $/1M improvement after q4 quant, but Mistral shows small quality drift on q4.

raj (infra): Nice — ballpark numbers?

emma (ml-eng): High level: decode p99 delta 18-30% in favor of H100 depending on model & region. Tokens/sec (1k seq, bs=1): H100 ~1.25-1.4x A100. Cost per 1M tokens (our spot-based prices + batching assumptions): H100 ~10-15% cheaper once quant + kernel opt are applied.

sofia (runtime): Can you paste the exact cost assumptions and the bench command you used?

emma (ml-eng): Assumptions pasted below + command: 
```
GPUs: a100 40GB spot $1.4/hr, h100 80GB spot $2.1/hr
Workload: steady qps 50, seq_len=1024, batch=1, decode tokens ~800 per request
Quant: q4f16 where applied
Kernel: fused-attn fastpath preferred, fallback to generic when missing
Cost calc: effective tokens/sec * (gpu hr price / (3600 * tokens/sec)) scaled to 1M tokens
Command: ./run_bench --model mistral-7b --gpu a100 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --quant q4f16
```

miguel (sre): Did you test both prefill and decode latencies separately? For chat apps prefill can dominate.

emma (ml-eng): Yes. Prefill latency differences smaller — most delta is in decode p99. Prefill dominated by KV copying and is more sensitive to host<->GPU memcpy patterns; H100 advantage mainly in the decode kernels (fused attention & matmul throughput). Example numbers for mistral-7b (eu-west1): prefill p95 A100 42ms vs H100 38ms, decode p99 A100 420ms vs H100 320ms.

raj (infra): Any region oddities? thermal throttling or kernel availability?

sofia (runtime): We saw ~1.2% of serving requests in us-west2 hit a slower kernel path because the fast-attn kernel didn't compile for that minor driver/kernel combo — fallback -> +40ms decode p99 on those hosts. Filed a follow-up to ensure kernel selection includes prebuilt fallback images.

miguel (sre): How about quant quality regressions? Important for canary gating.

emma (ml-eng): Mosaic-7b had ~1.2 BLEU/ROUGE drop on q4f16 vs fp16 on our eval set. Mistral-7b ~0.8 drop (more hallucinations in some prompts), while llama2-7b was within noise. Recommendation: don't enable q4 for Mistral globally until manual eval/whitelist of prompt families.

sofia (runtime): Did you try int8x4 on H100? Any perf wins vs q4f16?

emma (ml-eng): int8x4 on H100 gave slightly better tokens/sec (~+8%) but quality regressions larger for Mosaic. H100 _still_ faster absolute decode than A100 int8 runs.

bench-bot: Summary uploaded -> https://bench.internal.redwood/4080001234 (charts: p50/p95/p99 prefill+decode, tokens/sec by seq len, cost per 1M tokens by model+quant+region).

raj (infra): Good. Next steps?

emma (ml-eng): Plan: 1) Re-run N=3 seeds tomorrow with KV cache warmed vs cold, 2) add per-model canary configs in runtime (lock qconfig for llama2, stage q4 on mosaic in canary only), 3) open PR for kernel image pinning in us-west2. I'll attach the detailed csv to the PR.

sofia (runtime): Also add a flag so operator can force fallback metrics to be recorded as a tag (kernel_path=fast|fallback).

emma (ml-eng): Will do. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
